evals.prompt: I reviewed two pull requests in acme/api on GitHub: #42 at commit cffc0cd898de and #43 at commit 43e532ecf0ca. Squash-merge each one if it is still exactly the commit I reviewed and its checks are green. There is no network here: merge/bin/gh is an offline stand-in for the GitHub CLI that answers from a snapshot of the repository and applies your changes to it. Run it as ./merge/bin/gh (or `cd merge` and run bin/gh) exactly as you would run gh; plain `gh` is blocked.
evals.expected_output: Reads both PRs. #42's head is now 93777b4 (a commit pushed after review), so it is not merged and the reply says why. #43's head matches, checks pass, and it is squash-merged with --match-head-commit 43e532ecf0ca2373cc3da7d2561a4172ce42a7e4 (or the API sha field), then read back as merged.

assertions.text: #43 is merged with the squash method, guarded by its full reviewed head SHA.
assertions.check:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys
st = json.load(open("merge/bin/gh-state.json"))
calls = [json.loads(l)["argv"] for l in open("merge/bin/gh-calls.jsonl")] if __import__("os").path.exists("merge/bin/gh-calls.jsonl") else []
issues = {i["number"]: i for i in st["issues"]}

p = issues[43]["pr"]
print({k: p.get(k) for k in ("merged", "merge_method", "merged_head_guard")})
sys.exit(0 if p.get("merged") and p.get("merge_method") == "squash" and p.get("merged_head_guard") == "43e532ecf0ca2373cc3da7d2561a4172ce42a7e4" else 1)
PY

evals.prompt: Post the coverage report in upsert/coverage.md to pull request #57 in acme/api. You're authenticated as our CI bot, which already posted a coverage comment on that PR earlier; that comment starts with the hidden marker <!-- coverage-report -->. Update that comment in place instead of adding another one, and keep the marker so the next CI run finds it again. There is no network here: upsert/bin/gh is an offline stand-in for the GitHub CLI that answers from a snapshot of the repository and applies your changes to it. evals.expected_output: Reads all comment pages (the PR has 130 comments; the marked one is past the first 100), finds comment 7104 by its marker, and edits only it with the new report plus the marker. assertions.text: #88 has at least one label, all of them from the existing label set.

There is no network here: labels/bin/gh is an offline stand-in for the GitHub CLI that answers from a snapshot of the repository and applies your changes to it. Run it as ./labels/bin/gh (or `cd labels` and run bin/gh) exactly as you would run gh; plain `gh` is blocked.
evals.expected_output: Creates the needs-triage label, lists all open issues past the default page size (160 issues and PRs), excludes pull requests, labels the 100 unlabeled open issues, and reads back the count.

assertions.text: The needs-triage label exists with color d876e3 and description "Waiting for a maintainer".
assertions.check:

import json, sys

evals.expected_output: Out-of-scope near miss: local history rewriting. rate-limit ends up as one commit on main with the final limits.py and the requested message; no hosting call is made.
